name: Val Thorens Ski Week
tagline: Europe's highest ski resort with 600km of slopes
description: Val Thorens sits at 2300m, making it Europe's highest resort and guaranteeing excellent snow conditions throughout the season. Part of the vast Three Valleys ski area, you'll have access to 600km of interconnected pistes spanning three world-class resorts. Perfect for all abilities from beginner to expert.

reviews.author: James T.

tagline: Austrian charm meets world-class skiing in the Tyrol
